title: Schedule of Premium Loadings — Travel Protection Plans
content:
Two loadings attach to the premium of a Travel Protection Plans certificate. The age loading is read off the plan's ladder by the age of the oldest insured traveller, as a percentage of the base premium. The destination loading is the plan's single percentage for the declared destination region, likewise as a percentage of the base premium.

## Table A — Age loading ladder, per cent of base premium

| Plan | Under 36 | 36 to 55 | 56 to 65 | 66 to 75 | 76 and over |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 0 | 15 | 45 | 95 | 175 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 0 | 12 | 40 | 85 | 160 |
| TripGuard Plus | 0 | 10 | 35 | 75 | 145 |
| TripGuard Premier | 0 | 8 | 30 | 65 | 130 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 0 | 8 | 28 | 60 | 120 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 0 | 15 | 50 | 110 | 200 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 0 | 12 | 42 | 90 | 170 |

## Table B — Destination loading, per cent of base premium

| Plan | Destination loading |
| --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 25 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 22 |
| TripGuard Plus | 20 |
| TripGuard Premier | 18 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 18 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 25 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 20 |

## Footnotes to the schedule

(a) The age bands of Table A are whole years and they meet without a gap: a traveller of 35 falls in the first band at 0, a traveller of 36 in the second, a traveller of 55 still in the second, a traveller of 56 in the third, a traveller of 65 still in the third, a traveller of 66 in the fourth, a traveller of 75 still in the fourth, and a traveller of 76 in the fifth.

(b) The first band carries nothing on every plan, so a party whose oldest traveller is under 36 attracts no age loading at all whichever Travel Protection Plans plan is held.

(c) The two loadings of a plan are separate figures and each is stated in this schedule as a percentage of the base premium. A single-trip plan and a multi-trip plan alike read their loadings from these tables.
